whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a source pinned to protocol version 2.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a source pinned to protocol version 2.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm nuget.config no longer carries a source pinned to protocol version 2.
